data.duplicate_policy: unique raw records; may collapse real identical group bookings; no identity-level deduplication claim

column_review.hotel: input: anonymized property category; never a Vietnam property identifier
column_review.is_canceled: classification target / regression cohort filter only; never X
column_review.lead_time: input: creation-intended advance interval; snapshot-stability assumption
column_review.arrival_date_year: date construction/split only; not a numeric trend predictor
column_review.arrival_date_month: input: planned arrival month; mutable snapshot caveat
column_review.arrival_date_day_of_month: input: planned date -> weekday; mutable snapshot caveat
column_review.stays_in_weekend_nights: input: planned stay total only; recompute weekend share from date
column_review.stays_in_week_nights: input: planned stay total; mutable snapshot caveat
column_review.adults: input: declared guests; mutable snapshot caveat
column_review.children: input: declared guests; missing stays missing for train-only imputation
column_review.babies: input: declared guests; mutable snapshot caveat
column_review.meal: input: selected meal; mutable snapshot caveat
column_review.country: excluded: nationality may be confirmed at check-in; no identity proxy
column_review.market_segment: input: booking acquisition context; snapshot caveat
column_review.distribution_channel: input: booking acquisition channel; snapshot caveat
column_review.is_repeated_guest: excluded: guest history cannot be verified as-of creation
column_review.reserved_room_type: input: reserved anonymized code; no invented luxury-room mapping
column_review.assigned_room_type: excluded: operational assignment after initial request
column_review.deposit_type: excluded: deposit timing and policy assignment not verified as-of creation
column_review.agent: excluded: sparse anonymized ID, not an appropriate demo feature
column_review.company: excluded: sparse anonymized ID, not an appropriate demo feature
column_review.customer_type: input: declared booking party type; mutable snapshot caveat
column_review.adr: regression target only; excluded from cancellation X and ADR X
column_review.required_car_parking_spaces: excluded: request may be added after creation
column_review.total_of_special_requests: excluded: requests may accumulate after creation
column_review.reservation_status: outcome/cohort sanity check only; never X
column_review.reservation_status_date: label maturity metadata only; never X

caveats: Public Portuguese hotel data, arrivals 2015–2017; Aurum is a simulated resort.
ADR is a historical reference in original EUR units, not an optimal price or revenue uplift.
Creation-intended retrospective proxy: source snapshots are near arrival; initial attribute values are unavailable.
Creation date is derived from arrival minus lead_time; mutable arrival/lead_time can affect this proxy.
The arrival-window cohort is truncated; results do not represent every booking created in each month.
is_canceled includes No-Show; cancellation risk is not quote conversion or causal price elasticity.
Explanation changes show model associations, not causal effects.
